description: Golden set for AIOps Sentinel AI output evaluation. All contexts are virtual sample data (see README Data Disclaimer).
labeling_notes: expected_fault_types / expected_error_types are matched against the PARSED classification field, not the whole raw response.
Parser fallback values such as 'Unknown' are intentionally NOT valid labels; a fallback is counted as unmeasured, never as correct.
expected_keywords excludes section names mandated by the system prompt (e.g. 'action'), because section presence is already scored by completeness_score.
Labels use word stems (e.g. 'connect') so morphological variants such as 'connection' and 'connectivity' both match; variants are not enumerated per observed output.
